description: Angular component for managing quick links in the Thingsboard UI, including link selection, editing, adding, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: QuickLinkComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing quick links, including search, add, edit, delete, and display functionalities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls and link filtering logic.

methods.name: requiredLinkValidator
methods.description: Validates that the link input is not empty.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value based on external input.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the internal quickLink state.

methods.name: displayLinkFn
methods.description: Formats the display string for a link.

methods.name: fetchLinks
methods.description: Fetches links matching the search text.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Filters links based on a PageLink.

methods.name: allLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all available menu links, with caching.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if dirty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the link input field.

methods.name: switchToEditMode
methods.description: Enables edit mode for the quick link.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies changes to the quick link.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing mode.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new quick link.

methods.name: cancelAdd
methods.description: Cancels adding a new quick link.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current quick link.

methods.name: isEditing
methods.description: Checks if the component is in edit or add mode.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model with the current quick link ID.
